"""Helper utilities."""

def chunk_list(xs, n):
    """Split xs into consecutive chunks of size n; the last chunk may be shorter."""
    chunks = []
    for i in range(0, len(xs), n):
        # Each individual chunk must be a tuple, because the batcher treats chunks as immutable.
        chunks.append(tuple(xs[i : i + n]))
    return chunks
